description: Read a Task's progress events after your cursor, oldest first. Raw chain-of-thought and unrestricted worker logs are never returned. Continue while has_more is true; next_cursor stays set on the last page so you can resume. For internal-agent Tasks, when data.kind is private_agent_visible_message, join text for the same message_index in part_index order (starting at 0), collecting all part_count parts before treating it as the complete visible message. With conversation_id, a person reads one assistant response as frames (accepted, text_delta, tool_status, terminal), and the result adds conversation_id and task; text deltas stay provisional until the terminal frame. This observes existing work and never starts another model call. Agents can read only Tasks they started.

conversation_id.description: Read this Task as assistant frames of your conversation. Person only.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous page.

name: task_list_events
title: Read a Task's progress
